chapter: Opinions, Edgar Battle and closing stories
title: The brutes prank in Los Angeles

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: Oh yeah. Oh boy, musicians used to hate to see Eddie coming. He lifts barbells all day long. Oh yeah, Eddie Barfield. Boy I'll never forget one time in LA. It was the big brute, the little brute and the middle-sized brute. Clyde Hart, Art Tatum and Eddie Barfield, we were all in Los Angeles at the same time. Well I was staying there at the Dunbar Hotel and so this afternoon they'd all been somewhere and got drunk, and Clyde was a friend of mine, we were all with Stuff together. Let's go up to Cozy's room. Boy those son of a guns came up to my room, it was about four o'clock, three o'clock in the afternoon. Who is it? The little brute, which was Clyde. So I opened the door and there was Eddie Barfield, Art Tatum and Clyde. So Clyde was a little bit of a son of a gun, you know, and I could whip Clyde with my little finger. So Clyde came over to my bed, 'Get up out of bed!' I said, 'Oh Clyde, goodness.' 'Don't you want to get up? I got my boys with me. We'll get you out of bed.' I said 'Oh Clyde, why don't you stop all that, you know. Now you can't get
mad, because Art Tatum and Eddy Basfield, both of them drunk. Boy them son of a guns grabbed me, took me out of bed, put me under a cold shower, boy. And now you can't fight back.
Boy, and I just cursed Clyde out, Clyde laughing, you know, oh yea. The brute, they call him, Eddy Basfield. He's a rough son of a gun.
